text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho is a competition for the venerable Spring Shield. Biwa Hayahide looks on from the stands, listening to positive pre-race takes on Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian squares off against Mejiro McQueen and Mihono Bourbon. But no matter who she's up against, she only seeks to prove her own strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sparks fly between Narita Brian and the other two racers. Being the one who challenged everyone, she can't afford to lose.
